config.grain_rationale: One row per ACNC-registered charity; the record describes the registered legal entity and its registered business address. ABN is not guaranteed unique (duplicates/blanks occur), so record identity is content-derived.

record_id.rationale: ABN is blank in ~0.6% of rows and repeats for some entities, so it is not a reliable unique key; hash the full record content instead.

fields.rationale: Column explicitly named Charity_Legal_Name on the ACNC register = registered legal name.
Other names the charity is known by (trading/display names), explicitly separate from the legal name column.
ABN column; 100% checksum-valid in discovery profile (11-digit shape).
Charity_Website holds domains or http(s) URLs.
ACNC registration date; all values match DD/MM/YYYY shape.
Street address lines combined; Address_Type is uniformly 'Business' and some values are PO boxes, so this is a business/contact address.
Australian state abbreviations; state transform normalises and maps unknown to OTHER.
4-digit Australian postcodes; one 6-digit source defect fails validation by design.

Reviewer-directed fix. trim/collapse/upper, then strip trailing periods and spaces with regex_extract '^(.*?)[.\s]*$' so 'Australia.' structurally reduces to 'AUSTRALIA' before lookup (general rule, not one hardcoded dotted key). map_enum(passthrough=true) maps 'AUSTRALIA'/'AU'/'AUS' -> 'AU' and passes any unlisted letter-only name (ARUBA, SINGAPORE) through unchanged as uppercase text, so genuine foreign countries are neither dropped nor guessed. A final regex_extract '^(\D*)$' returns the value only when it contains no digits, so state+postcode mistypes such as 'WA 6105' become null instead of being emitted as a country; letter-only names are unaffected. 'default: null' is deliberately NOT used, since it would also null real foreign countries.

config.notes: Reviewer feedback addressed: address.country now uses map_enum with passthrough=true (no '__PASSTHROUGH__' sentinel); listed Australian spellings -> 'AU', other countries preserved as uppercase text. entity.status is NOT mapped: no per-row status column and the extract may include revoked charities, so asserting 'active' would be guesswork. entity_type not mapped: suffixes (Incorporated/Ltd/Trust) are name text, not a structured type field. Columns 29-69 are charitable-purpose/beneficiary Y/N flags with no ontology target. Some Other_Organisation_Names values are person-like (e.g. 'Shannon Schedlich'); trading_name confidence kept moderate for that reason. No per-row observation date; fallback to resource last-modified. Address is a business/contact address (Address_Type uniformly 'Business'), so address.full confidence is moderate. One 6-digit Postcode source defect fails validation by design.
